claim: When a monitored structured field keeps the same schema but its value changes, the change-type label to record is value_changed
sub_question: When a monitored structured field keeps the same schema but its value changes, which change-type label should be recorded?
evidence: Diff Output Format defines Change Type as one of field_added, field_removed, value_changed, or structure_changed; value_changed applies when field values differ under an unchanged schema.
notes: Structured field comparison is the method for API/JSON field values; structure_changed would cover schema shape changes, not same-schema value updates.
